newsitem.title: CHINA: Saomao approves dividend, bonus issue.
newsitem.headline: Saomao approves dividend, bonus issue.

text.p: Shareholders of Shanghai Sanmao Textiles Co have approved a pre-tax cash dividend of 0.05 yuan per share based on the firm's 1996 net profit, a company statement said on Wednesday.
The shareholders at a meeting on Monday also approved a one-for-10 bonus share issue from the firm's capital reserves, the statement said.
The dividend for foreign currency B shares will be exchanged into U.S. dollars at an exchange rate of 8.2924 yuan to the dollar, the statement said.
Ex-dividend and ex-rights date for B shares will be July 8 and for domestic A shares will be July 7, the statement said.
The firm in its 1996 annual report issued in late April said it recorded net profit of 5.591 million yuan in 1996, down from 8.442 million in 1995 based on international accounting standards.
Under domestic accounting standards, net profit plunged 49.43 percent to 10.240 million yuan for 1996, compared with 20.250 million in 1995, the report said.
The fall in profits was due to falling prices for textile products and continued high prices for raw materials, it said.
